title: Japanese Lamb Kebabs
description: A unique twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, featuring flavorful lamb kebabs infused with Saudi Arabian spices.

ingredients.name: Sahlab spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, Sahlab spice mix, and a pinch of salt.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with a little sesame oil and season with sumac (if using).
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer skewers to a plate and garnish with mint leaves and a sprinkle of sumac (if using).
Serve with lemon wedges and a side of exotic fruit chutney and pomegranate seeds (if using).
